name: systemthinkinglab
description: Systems Thinking Lab's free tools: design an app, review a design, and build it plan-first with a mentor, all on the 7 Universal Building Blocks.

plugins.name: design-with-blocks
plugins.description: Design an application using the 7 Universal Building Blocks framework: decompose features into blocks, get per-block technology recommendations, and output a buildable design doc.

plugins.name: review-with-blocks
plugins.description: Review a finished system design against the 7 Universal Building Blocks and the non-functional '-ilities': decompose it, flag wrong/missing blocks, rate each load-bearing -ility, and surface the questions a senior would ask. The design-review end of design → build → review.

plugins.name: scaffold
plugins.description: A plan-first developer workflow, run by an AI mentor: it predicts before it builds, keeps a compounding wiki of your codebase, and holds an honest ledger of what you've demonstrated you know, in craft or direction mode.
